observation_reviews.rationale: The two independently reconstructed flags demonstrate that existing identity/issuer_name_printed catches this observed suffix leakage. Original company cells omit Membership Interest while typed members contain it; wrapper issuer_name_strip_re removes comma-delimited Common equity but does not remove the preceding Membership Interest. Keeping the existing detector is supported for this observed shape; it is advisory and page-anchor dependent, not proof of universal name accuracy. Narrowly preserving the instrument and separate position avoids merging distinct interests. This observation repeats the two selected errors and adds no extra error count.
